_what: The numerals of SI Tables S2, S3 and S4, transcribed by reading the embedded bitmaps. These three tables have no text layer (stage00_scan_for_values.py proves it), so this file is the hand-off point between pixels and arithmetic. Everything downstream is exact arithmetic on these integers.

_how_read.method: the page's embedded PNG extracted at its native resolution (no page re-render), then read visually; Table S2 at 2x LANCZOS whole-table, Tables S3/S4 at 2x LANCZOS whole-table
_how_read.second_independent_read: each table read a SECOND time from a DIFFERENT crop at a DIFFERENT magnification -- Table S2 as two half-height crops of the right-hand columns at 2.4x, Tables S3/S4 as a label-column + LECs-column composite at 2.0x. Agreement is recorded in 07_qc.json.
_how_read.no_geometry: no axis, no scale, no origin, no colour ramp and no bar is involved; these are printed numerals. curation/lib's axis/bars/heatmap modules are deliberately NOT used because there is nothing for them to measure.

table_S2.caption: Table S2. Average LEC count and LEC/aVHH+ cell count for lead LEC-specific LNP candidates, namely LNP1, LNP2, LNP3, LNP4, LNP7, and LNP11.
table_S2.cohort: Figure 2 validation study: each LNP administered INDIVIDUALLY, intradermally, into BOTH paws.

table_S3.caption: Table S3. Average cell count for the various cell types found in ALN, BLN, PLN Contralateral (non-injected), PLN injected, and PLV for saline-, free aVHH-, MC3-, and LNP7-injected animals.
table_S3.cohort: Figure 4 study: ONE hindlimb injected, so ALN, BLN and PLN Contralateral are off-target control sites and PLN Injected and PLV are the draining sites.

table_S4.caption: Table S4. Average aVHH+ cell count for the various cell types found in ALN, BLN, PLN Contralateral (non-injected), PLN injected, and PLV for saline-, free aVHH, MC3-, and LNP7-injected animals.

printed_percentages_in_main_text._what: verbatim percentages from the PMC full text, used only as a CROSS-CHECK on the derivation, never as a value source.
